text:
emi (Design): uploaded a compact RBAC mock: roles matrix (rows) x resources (cols), inline cell select (None/View/Manage), invite modal tweaks, SSO toggle placement, and a slimmer audit log panel. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rw-rbac-compact 

rafe (PM): goal: fewer clicks for admins and clearer signals for billing/key perms. recommend capability badges and a stronger primary CTA 'Send invite'.

zoe_f (Frontend): prefer a select per cell for keyboard nav; row-first tab order. open row drawer for details instead of full page. mobile -> accordion.

pat_sec (Security): copy must say 'View = metadata only' for keys. SSO toggle should show "Enforce SSO" consequences and be gated to org-admins. audit events required for toggle flips and invite acceptances (actor, ip).

lee_ops (EngOps): for import/export add CSV with role_id,name,perms_hex. import endpoint must accept client_request_id for idempotency. pagination for audit log via cursor to avoid client load.

emi (Design): added ARIA notes: aria-describedby for badges, visible focus ring, and high-contrast variants. moved SSO toggle above invite section and added help tooltip copy.

rafe (PM): rollout plan: feature-flag `rbac_compact_v1`, alpha internal + 1 customer, telemetry on role changes. tick to dev?

ux-bot: created task RED-UI-512: "RBAC compact matrix + invite flow" and linked Figma.

zoe_f (Frontend): :thumbsup: will add keyboard-nav unit tests.

pat_sec (Security): will post gating checklist in #eng-security later today.

emi (Design): thanks everyone! react with :eyes: if ok to convert to tickets.
